propositions: the ticket-type map (_LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE) is duplicated across two adapter create paths (Cloud and DC) with no guard preventing future copies
a prior defect (fe15) allowed a status map to drift across copies before detection; the same risk exists for the type map, which must be unified and guarded like the status and priority maps

the module-level import alias (_LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE) must be preserved in both outbound_fields.py and backend.py so external consumers reading it as a module attribute continue to work without modification
the boundary guard test suite must be extended to enforce exactly one type-map literal under adapters/, mutation-checked to verify it fails when a second copy is reintroduced
both Cloud and DC create paths must pin the built issuetype field by value for all four local types (task/story/bug/epic) to detect any divergence introduced by the consolidation
